finding.comment: The intro's absolute wording reads like it contradicts the Probes section, but the exception is scoped into the same sentence and restated below — the claims are compatible, not contradictory.

files.patch:
--- /dev/null
+++ b/docs/caching.md
@@ -0,0 +1,9 @@
+# Response caching
+
+All API responses are served from the cache, except health probes,
+which bypass it by design.
+
+## Probes
+
+/health and /metrics bypass the cache and always hit origin services;
+this is the documented exception noted above.

rationale: same wording family; exception scoped and compatible
